body:
Addressed: the conflict with `main`. This PR had no open review finding.

New head: `aacd3c1c5c78b53c5305a2342d82c646e40922d9`. Writer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3071#issuecomment-7230742813 (takeover for sn3ro, approved by the maintainer).

What changed:
- The commit merges `upstream/main` (2394b5ad1) into the branch. There is no rebase and no force-push. The author's commits stay.
- One file had a conflict: `crates/app/tests/machine.rs`. The two sides each added one test module at the same line. The merge keeps the two: `hobby_routers` (#3071) and `laser_kind` (#4081).
- There are no other hand edits. The class is DELTA, but the resolution only adds lines.
- `main` added a laser machine kind (#4081). The six new `.mch` files have no `kind` key, so they stay mill frames. The suites below show that they still load and validate.

Tests on the new head (local build, debug):
- `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test machine`: 65 passed. This includes the four `hobby_routers::` pins and the `laser_kind::` tests from `main`.
- `machine_library` 17, `shipped_from_disk` 3, `conformance` 7, `machine_key_order` 2, `post_spindle_rule_all` 5, `post_not_judged` 4: all pass.
- `example_catalog` 50 passed, 4 ignored. `example_catalog_adaptive` 1 and `example_catalog_edge_work` 1 pass. No golden changed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --lib --test machine -- -D warnings`: clean.

Not run:
- The full quick gate. `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` plans every `camcraft-app` test binary, because the diff touches `crates/app/src/posting_files.rs`. Its build step stalled on this host: the shared sccache server did not answer compile requests. The run records 1 STALL and 0 FAIL. The targeted suites above were built without sccache.
- The light lane and the site tests.

Please do a re-review of this head.

Reviewer record for PR #4263. The writer record https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3071#issuecomment-7230742813 is released (https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3071#issuecomment-7233040463).

Reviewer: m3 pool job review-4263, claude-opus-5-5, mkinney (config /Users/mikekinney/.claude-team2); did not write or refresh this PR.

**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (a `feat`: it merges at the next cut).

This is the first review of this PR. Reviewer record: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/pull/4263#issuecomment-7233055762

## What looks good

- The PR adds six machine files with the "Grbl 1.1" post: Shapeoko 5 Pro 4x4, 4x2 and 2x2, X-Carve 2021 1000 mm, and X-Carve Pro 4x4 and 4x2. Each value has a source row in `docs/decisions/3071-hobby-routers.md`.
- The files state only the published figures. They state no axis rates, no `safe_retract` and no coolant. The decision file records why: no maker states where machine Z0 is after homing. The post therefore lifts Z in the work offset and does not guess a `G53` lift.
- The registry (`MACHINES`) and the embedded copies agree, row for row, for the six files. No packaging list in `xtask/`, `scripts/` or `.github/` names single machine files.
- The tests join the existing `machine` directory suite (`machine/hobby_routers.rs`). The PR adds no new test binary. The test module has its provenance lines.
- The PR changes no process file, no UI, no post script, no CHANGELOG and no snapshot PNG. The body has a `Changelog:` line and `Refs #3071`. The issue stays open for Onefinity, which is correct.

## Golden (new, not moved)

I read `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/grbl/shapeoko_5_pro_4x4_two_tool.nc` line by line against `assets/posts/grbl.cps` (lines 447-470) and against `grbl/drill_plate.nc`:
- The header is the model comment, then `G21 G17 G90 G91.1 G94 G40 G80`.
- T3: `G0 Z15` (the clearance plane in the work offset), the "LOAD T3" note, `S18000 M3`, rapids, then `G1 ... Z-1 F1500`. The stream gives 1500000 µm/min, which is 1500 mm/min.
- The change: `M5`, the safe-start block, `G0 Z15`, the "TOOL CHANGE - LOAD T4" note, then `M0`. Z lifts before the stop.
- T4: `S12000 M3`, the plunge `F300`, the retract, `M5`, `G0 Z15`, `M30`.
- There is no `M6`, `G53`, `G28` or `G30`. The program is correct for Grbl 1.1. No other recorded program changed.

## Results (built locally on m3, trial-merged with upstream/main 2394b5ad1)

The PR head already holds upstream/main 2394b5ad1, so the trial merge was "Already up to date".

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: 721 steps. The registry is in the app lib, so the plan selects every app suite. The author reports the full plan: 766 steps, 0 failed. I did not run the full plan again. I ran the suites that read the machine registry:

| Suite (`camcraft-app`) | Result |
|---|---|
| `--lib` | 329 passed, 0 failed |
| `machine` (includes `hobby_routers` and `every_shipped_machine_mounts_and_speaks_its_declaration`) | 65 passed, 0 failed |
| `machine_library` | 17 passed |
| `machine_edit` | 13 passed |
| `mcp_setup` | 9 passed |
| `altmill_machines` | 4 passed |
| `first_router_part` | 4 passed |
| `router_kind` | 4 passed |
| `machine_assign` | 3 passed |
| `shipped_from_disk` | 3 passed |
| `folder_lists` | 2 passed |
| `cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -p camcraft-app -- -D warnings` | clean |

Extra suites run:
- Test data: the new golden directory `crates/app/tests/golden/nc/grbl/` has no directory reader. No test lists that folder (I searched for `read_dir` on the golden paths). Only `hobby_routers.rs` reads the new file. No `testdata/` file changed.
- Importers: the PR does not touch import code, so no kernel suite is owed.
- Site (the user guide changed): `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests` gives 126 passed and 6 errors. All 6 errors are in `test_search_query` and say `FileNotFoundError: 'node'`. This host has no Node.js, and the gate step "site tests" gives `SKIPPED (tool missing: node)`. The errors are an environment gap and are not caused by this PR. The PR changes only Markdown text in `site/content/guide/check-and-post/machines.md`.
- Example catalog and heavy lanes: not run. The PR changes no post, operation, motion code or catalog file, so "Heavy lanes at review" does not ask for them.

## Mutations (safety tier: the PR adds new posted programs)

| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `inventables-x-carve-pro-4x4.mch` `max_speed` 24000 -> 30000 | red: `a_spindle_speed_past_the_stated_maximum_is_refused` (hobby_routers.rs:123) |
| `carbide3d-shapeoko-5-pro-4x4.mch` Z travel 155 -> 150 | red: `every_hobby_router_states_only_its_published_figures` (hobby_routers.rs:86) |
| Both files restored | green, 4/4 |

## Requested before merge

None.

## Optional, non-blocking (follow-up, suggested P7)

1. `crates/app/tests/router_kind.rs:20` - `ROUTERS` does not list the six new files. Each new file states `"kind": "router"`. But `every_shipped_machine_mounts_and_speaks_its_declaration` checks only `Kind::Mill`, and a file with `"mill"` also passes that check. Thus no test pins the router kind of the new files. Add the six names to `ROUTERS` (it is a fixed-size array, so change its length too).

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
